purpose: Make Nexus Mods a first-class reference and authorized-asset discovery input for original Witching Hour 3D game production, alongside Blender/Eevee, Meshy candidate workflows, Godot 4 and the Python/FFmpeg Forge.
discoveryOrder: nexusMods metadata/creator permissions and code projects
clearly-licensed open community source: original Blender/Godot tools
CC0 Kenney and Poly Haven fast-lane for shippable set dressing
per-asset OpenGameArt/Godot plugins with upstream licenses
targetFamilies: original gothic adult outfit construction studies
cloth hair accessories and physics architecture
VFX shader audio ambient texture sources
mod management and plugin architecture code
assetPipeline: 1. Discover exact Nexus mod page and creator without scraping or copying
2. Record per-file rights, author, upstream-game IP and any separate executable code license
3. Keep Nexus references and unsuitable donor binaries in private quarantined storage only if access/storage itself is permitted
4. Check author authorization for *off-game* reuse and modification before any mesh import
5. Check game/publisher IP and third-party dependencies independently
6. Use Blender Python/Eevee to create or adapt only authorized original assets, preserve source and notices
7. Export signed-off candidate as GLB/audio/image only after runtime/content-lane admission
8. Import into Godot 4, confirm deformation/motion + phone/HTML performance
9. Record immutable hashes, owner approval, attribution/notice and distribution rights before beta/public CAST

adapterModes.referenceOnly: Store metadata and link (not binary); no runtime import permission implied.
adapterModes.permittedPrivatePrototype: Requires verified legal authorization to use the selected file beyond its original game, including adaptation and any relevant site conditions; store privately.
adapterModes.distributionCandidate: Requires all private prototype evidence PLUS explicit redistribution and commercial rights appropriate to the planned build and source-game licenses; remains unshipped.
